title: Youth coalition rallies in Paris against living costs and military spending
seoTitle: Paris youth rally against living costs

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against the rising cost of living, housing shortages, poor learning conditions, and increased military spending.
tea.want: Demands include an end to militarisation, investment in education and welfare, climate justice, and a radical transformation of the system.
tea.changed: Nov 20: Coordinated rallies took place across Europe, including in France, organised by a coalition of over 50 youth and student groups.

summary: On November 20, 2026, a youth-led coalition organised coordinated protests across more than 20 European countries, including France, under the slogan “fight for our future, not their wars”. In Paris and other cities, participants rallied against the surging cost of living, housing crises, deteriorating educational conditions, and rising military budgets. The movement, which involves over 50 youth and student organisations, also includes the participation of the gilets jaunes (yellow vests) in France. Protesters demanded an end to militarisation and conscription, increased investment in public services, and social justice. The demonstrations follow weeks of smaller protests in several European nations. While organisers emphasised the need for a radical systemic transformation, no specific government response to the Paris rally was reported in the provided sources.
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Coordinated rallies held across Europe, including France, by the Youth Strike coalition and other groups.
